overview: The NPC behavior subsystem encompasses 763 types across 70+ packages under com.hypixel.hytale.server.npc. It implements a data-driven behavior system where NPC types are defined via JSON role assets loaded through a BuilderManager. Each NPC is an entity with a Role that contains Instructions (behavior tree nodes), Sensors (condition evaluators), Actions (effect executors), and Motions (movement/head controllers). The system uses a blackboard architecture for shared perception data, an A* pathfinding implementation for navigation, expression evaluation for dynamic config values, and an ECS-based tick pipeline with 25+ registered systems.

root_package.overview: The root npc package contains the plugin entry point and the AllNPCsLoadedEvent. NPCPlugin is the central registration hub — it registers all ECS component types, resource types, systems, asset stores, commands, event handlers, and the builder factory system that maps JSON type names to Java builder classes.

types.name: NPCPlugin
types.purpose: Central plugin entry point. Registers all NPC ECS systems (~25 systems), component types (~12 types), resource types (~6 types), asset stores (AttitudeGroup, ItemAttitudeGroup, BalanceAsset, Condition), commands (NPCCommand), interactions (UseNPC, ContextualUseNPC, SpawnNPC), and the builder factory system with ~100 named builder registrations for Actions, Sensors, BodyMotions, HeadMotions, Instructions, EntityFilters, EntityPrioritisers, and MotionControllers.

types.name: AllNPCsLoadedEvent
types.purpose: Event fired when all NPC role assets have been loaded. Carries maps of all NPCs and loaded NPCs (Int2ObjectMap<BuilderInfo>).

entities.overview: The entities sub-package contains NPCEntity (the core NPC component on every NPC) and PathManager (manages path-following state). NPCEntity extends LivingEntity and implements INonPlayerCharacter.

types.name: NPCEntity
types.purpose: Core component attached to every NPC entity. Holds the Role reference, spawn information (role name/index, spawn role, environment, spawn configuration, spawn instant), leash position/heading/pitch, hover state, damage data, blackboard views (BlockTypeView, BlockEventView, EntityEventView), alarm store, path manager, despawn state, reserved-by set, and model scale. Has serialization via BuilderCodec.

types.name: PathManager
types.purpose: Manages the NPC's current path. Can hold either a prefab path (UUID-referenced) or a transient path. Serializes currentPathHint UUID.

asset_config.overview: The asset/builder sub-package (~165 types) implements a JSON-driven builder/factory system for NPC configuration. NPC roles are defined in JSON files under Server/NPC/Roles/*.json. The BuilderManager loads these files and uses a factory pattern to instantiate builders of specific types (Role, Action, Sensor, BodyMotion, HeadMotion, Instruction, etc.). The builder sub-packages include: expression evaluators for dynamic JSON values, holder types for validated field storage, provider evaluators for feature/parameter resolution, validators for asset validation at load time, and utility classes.

key_types.name: BuilderManager
key_types.purpose: Manages loading/unloading of NPC role JSON assets from asset packs. Maintains categories (Role, Action, Sensor, etc.) and the factory registry.

key_types.name: Builder
key_types.purpose: Base interface/class for all NPC builders. A builder reads JSON and produces a runtime object (Role, Action, Sensor, etc.).

key_types.name: BuilderInfo
key_types.purpose: Metadata about a loaded NPC builder (name, index, validation state, etc.).

key_types.name: BuilderFactory
key_types.purpose: Factory for creating builders from JSON type discriminators.

key_types.name: BuilderSupport
key_types.purpose: Support context passed to builders during construction, providing access to the builder manager and expression compiler.

key_types.name: BuilderDescriptor
key_types.purpose: Describes a builder type's schema for documentation/validation generation.

key_types.name: SpawnableWithModelBuilder
key_types.purpose: Builder that also supports spawning with a model (used by role builders).

key_types.name: InstructionContextHelper
key_types.purpose: Helps builders resolve instruction references and build instruction trees.

key_types.name: StateMappingHelper
key_types.purpose: Maps state names to indices for the state machine system.

key_types.name: BuilderCombatConfig
key_types.purpose: Builder for NPC combat configuration (attack interactions, damage, etc.).

movement.overview: The movement sub-package handles NPC locomotion with three motion controller types (Walk, Fly, Dive), steering behaviors (Pursue, Evade, Wander, Rotate, AvoidCollision), and group flocking support. MotionController is the interface; MotionControllerBase provides shared collision/physics logic; specific controllers handle ground walking, flying, and diving/swimming.

controllers.name: MotionController
controllers.purpose: Interface for all motion controllers. Defines probeMove(), waypointDistance(), isValidPosition(), getComponentSelector(), is2D(), getWorldNormal(), requirePreciseMovement(), enableHeadingBlending(), etc.

controllers.name: MotionControllerBase
controllers.purpose: Base implementation with collision detection, movement physics, bounding box management, heading interpolation, speed computation, and step-up/step-down logic.

controllers.name: MotionControllerWalk
controllers.purpose: Ground-based walking controller. Handles gravity, jumping, climbing, step-up over blocks, fluid interaction, ground snapping, and 2D pathfinding (y-axis projected out of search).

controllers.name: MotionControllerFly
controllers.purpose: Flying controller for airborne NPCs. Handles 3D movement, hover height, altitude constraints, take-off/landing transitions.

controllers.name: MotionControllerDive
controllers.purpose: Swimming/diving controller for aquatic NPCs. Handles fluid-based movement with material checks (COLLISION_MATERIALS_ACTIVE = 5).

controllers.name: BuilderMotionControllerMap
controllers.purpose: Builder for a map of named motion controllers, allowing NPCs to switch between Walk/Fly/Dive modes.

controllers.name: ProbeMoveData
controllers.purpose: Data structure for probing movement validity. Contains probe position, direction, target position, and segment tracking for path smoothing.

steering.overview: Steering forces implement Craig Reynolds-style behaviors. Each force computes a desired Steering output (translation + rotation). Forces are composed by the SteeringSystem.

types.name: SteeringForce
types.purpose: Base interface: compute(Steering) -> bool.

types.name: SteeringForceWithTarget
types.purpose: Base for target-tracking forces (selfPosition + targetPosition).

types.name: SteeringForceWithGroup
types.purpose: Base for group-aware forces (spatial queries over nearby entities).

types.name: SteeringForcePursue
types.purpose: Seek/pursue a target with slowdown and stop distances. Uses inverse-distance falloff.

types.name: SteeringForceEvade
types.purpose: Flee from a target with slowdown/stop distances and direction hints.

types.name: SteeringForceWander
types.purpose: Random wandering with jitter and turn intervals.

types.name: SteeringForceRotate
types.purpose: Rotate to face a desired heading with angular tolerance.

types.name: SteeringForceAvoidCollision
types.purpose: Avoid collisions with nearby entities using time-to-collision prediction. Configurable falloff and strength.

other_types.name: Steering
other_types.purpose: Mutable steering vector with translation (Vector3d), yaw/pitch/roll, maxDistance, relativeTurnSpeed. Has clear/assign/scale operations.

other_types.name: GroupSteeringAccumulator
other_types.purpose: Accumulates separation/cohesion/alignment vectors from nearby entities. Used by flocking and avoidance systems.

roles.overview: Roles define NPC behavior profiles. Role is the runtime object that holds the instruction tree, motion controllers, support objects, and state machine. Roles are built from JSON via BuilderRole/BuilderRoleAbstract/BuilderRoleVariant. Support classes handle entity tracking, combat, debug, state management, and world interaction.

role_types.name: Role
role_types.purpose: The primary runtime NPC behavior profile. Contains the instruction tree (behavior tree), motion controllers (map of Walk/Fly/Dive), support objects (EntitySupport, CombatSupport, DebugSupport, StateSupport, WorldSupport, MarkedEntitySupport, PositionCache, RoleStats), state machine (StateTransitionController), avoidance/separation steering, flags, and entity stat setup.

role_types.name: BuilderRole
role_types.purpose: JSON builder for Role objects. Reads all role configuration fields from JSON.

role_types.name: BuilderRoleAbstract
role_types.purpose: Abstract role that cannot be spawned directly (isSpawnable() returns false). Used as base templates.

role_types.name: BuilderRoleVariant
role_types.purpose: Role variant that inherits from and modifies a base role template.

role_types.name: RoleDebugDisplay
role_types.purpose: Renders debug overlays for NPCs (state, time, flock, animation, targets, light, HP, stamina, speed, pathfinder, etc.).

role_types.name: RoleDebugFlags
role_types.purpose: 36 debug flags including TraceFail, TraceSuccess, TraceSensorFailures, Flock, MotionControllerSteer/Move, Collisions, DisplayState/HP/Stamina/Speed, Pathfinder, VisAvoidance/Separation/Aiming/MarkedTargets/SensorRanges/LeashPosition/Flock, BeaconMessages, etc.

role_types.name: RoleUtils
role_types.purpose: Static utilities for setting hotbar items, off-hand items, item-in-hand, and armor on NPC inventories.

role_types.name: SpawnEffect
role_types.purpose: Interface for spawn particle effects (getSpawnParticles, getSpawnParticleOffset, getSpawnViewDistance).

support_types.name: CombatSupport
support_types.purpose: Manages NPC combat -- attack tags (Melee/Ranged/Block), interaction chains, entity groups, damage dealing permission.

support_types.name: DebugSupport
support_types.purpose: Manages debug flags, display strings, trace state for instruction matching.

support_types.name: EntitySupport
support_types.purpose: Manages display names, entity stat setup, instruction execution control.

support_types.name: EntityList
support_types.purpose: Bucketed entity list with 6 priority buckets for entity tracking (players, NPCs at various ranges).

support_types.name: MarkedEntitySupport
support_types.purpose: Manages named target slots (e.g. 'LockedTarget') for entity targeting. Supports multiple named target slots mapped to indices.

support_types.name: StateSupport
support_types.purpose: Manages the NPC state machine -- current state, state transitions, interactable state, event view integration.

support_types.name: WorldSupport
support_types.purpose: Manages world-aware NPC features -- attitude system (via blackboard AttitudeView), NPC groups, block type awareness, weather awareness, item attitudes.

support_types.name: PositionCache
support_types.purpose: Caches NPC spatial data -- position, bounding box, line-of-sight checks, block iteration, dropped item detection, block placement probing.

support_types.name: RoleStats
support_types.purpose: Tracks NPC detection ranges per range type (player vs NPC) for sensor optimization.

expression_system.overview: A complete expression evaluator with lexer, parser (Shunting-Yard algorithm), AST, and stack-based virtual machine. Used throughout the NPC system for dynamic JSON configuration values (e.g. 'speed * 1.5 + random()'). Supports NUMBER, STRING, BOOLEAN, and array types.

compiler_pipeline.purpose: Tokenizes expression strings into Token enums. Handles identifiers, strings, numbers, and operators.
Shunting-Yard parser that produces parsed tokens in postfix order. Handles operator precedence, brackets, function calls, and tuple construction.
Builds an AST from parsed tokens, performs type checking, constant folding, and generates a list of ExecutionContext.Instruction lambdas.
Stack-based virtual machine that executes Instruction lambdas. Operand stack with NUMBER/STRING/BOOLEAN/ARRAY operands.

scope_system.overview: Scopes provide variable/function bindings for expression evaluation. StdScope is a HashMap-based scope with parent chaining. StdLib is the root scope with constants and built-in functions.

commands.overview: 23 NPC-related command classes under the /npc command tree. Commands are registered by NPCPlugin.setup() via NPCCommand (the root command collection).

types.name: NPCCommand
types.purpose: Root command collection (/npc). Registers all sub-commands.

types.name: NPCAllCommand
types.purpose: Operate on all NPCs in range (e.g. despawn all).

types.name: NPCAppearanceCommand
types.purpose: Change NPC model/appearance at runtime.

types.name: NPCAttackCommand
types.purpose: Force NPC to execute an attack interaction.

types.name: NPCBenchmarkCommand
types.purpose: Toggle NPC tick/sensor performance benchmarking.

types.name: NPCBlackboardCommand
types.purpose: Inspect blackboard state (block types, events, attitudes).

types.name: NPCCleanCommand
types.purpose: Remove all NPCs from a world.

types.name: NPCCommandUtils
types.purpose: Shared utility for resolving target NPC from command context.

types.name: NPCDebugCommand
types.purpose: Set debug flags on NPCs (display state, trace sensors, etc.).

types.name: NPCDumpCommand
types.purpose: Dump NPC state to JSON for debugging.

types.name: NPCFreezeCommand
types.purpose: Freeze NPC ticking (pause behavior).

types.name: NPCGiveCommand
types.purpose: Give item to NPC inventory.

types.name: NPCMessageCommand
types.purpose: Send beacon/event messages to NPCs.

types.name: NPCMultiSelectCommandBase
types.purpose: Base for commands that operate on multiple selected NPCs.

types.name: NPCPathCommand
types.purpose: Create/assign transient paths to NPCs.

types.name: NPCRoleCommand
types.purpose: Change NPC role at runtime.

types.name: NPCRunTestsCommand
types.purpose: Run NPC behavior test suite (coverage, validation).

types.name: NPCSensorStatsCommand
types.purpose: Display sensor execution statistics.

types.name: NPCSpawnCommand
types.purpose: Spawn NPCs of a given role type at a location.

types.name: NPCStepCommand
types.purpose: Step NPC behavior one tick at a time (debug).

types.name: NPCTestCommand
types.purpose: Run specific NPC tests (pathfinding, collision, etc.).

types.name: NPCThawCommand
types.purpose: Unfreeze previously frozen NPCs.

types.name: NPCWorldCommandBase
types.purpose: Base for world-scoped NPC commands.

navigation.overview: A* pathfinding implementation with half-block resolution (0.5 unit grid), support for 2D and 3D search, diagonal movement, path optimization, and path smoothing. Uses a node pool for allocation efficiency.
navigation.algorithm: A* with sorted open list (sorted by totalCost descending, popped from end), Long2ObjectMap for visited blocks, half-block position indexing (11 bits per axis, 1024 offset), configurable max path length (200), open node limit (80), total node limit (400). Supports 2D mode (4 or 8 directions) and 3D mode (6 or 26 directions). Path building does direction-change optimization (only keeping corner nodes).

types.name: AStarBase
types.purpose: Core A* implementation. initComputePath() sets up start nodes, computePath() processes nodes iteratively. Handles position-to-index encoding, search direction setup, path building.

types.name: AStarWithTarget
types.purpose: Extends AStarBase with a target position. Also supports findClosestPath() for partial paths.

types.name: AStarNode
types.purpose: A* graph node with position, travelCost, estimateToGoal, totalCost, predecessor chain, successor array (one per search direction), and step costs.

types.name: AStarEvaluator
types.purpose: Strategy interface: isGoalReached() and estimateToGoal() (heuristic function).

types.name: AStarNodePool
types.purpose: Object pool for AStarNode instances (allocate/deallocate).

types.name: AStarNodePoolSimple
types.purpose: Simple list-based node pool.

types.name: AStarNodePoolProvider
types.purpose: Provides pools keyed by child node count.

types.name: AStarNodePoolProviderSimple
types.purpose: ECS resource that provides node pools per entity store.

types.name: PathFollower
types.purpose: Follows a path of IWaypoint nodes. Handles waypoint advancement, path smoothing (binary search for line-of-sight shortcuts), heading blending at corners, and frozen waypoints.

types.name: IWaypoint
types.purpose: Interface for path waypoints: getLength(), getPosition(), advance(skip), next().

types.name: AStarDebugBase
types.purpose: Debug visualization of A* state -- ASCII map rendering with open/closed/path nodes.

types.name: AStarDebugWithTarget
types.purpose: Debug helper that also shows target position.

instructions.overview: The instruction system implements a behavior tree. Instructions are the tree nodes, each containing a Sensor (condition), optional child instructions, a BodyMotion, a HeadMotion, and an ActionList. The system evaluates sensors to select which instruction to execute, then runs the corresponding motions and actions.

types.name: Instruction
types.purpose: Behavior tree node. Contains sensor, child instruction array, bodyMotion, headMotion, actionList. Evaluated recursively -- sensor must match for the instruction to activate. Has name, tag, index, weight fields.

types.name: InstructionRandomized
types.purpose: Randomly selects among child instructions using a WeightedMap. Supports resetOnStateChange and executeFor time ranges.

types.name: Sensor
types.purpose: Condition evaluator. matches() returns true if the sensor condition is met. Has getSensorInfo() for passing data to actions, processDelay() for cooldowns, clearOnce()/setOnce()/isTriggered() for one-shot sensors.

types.name: NullSensor
types.purpose: Always-true sensor (default when no sensor specified).

types.name: Action
types.purpose: Side-effect executor. canExecute()/execute() methods run effects when an instruction activates. Has activate()/deactivate() lifecycle.

types.name: ActionList
types.purpose: Sequence of Actions with blocking and atomic modes. Executes actions in order; blocking mode waits for each to complete.

types.name: Motion
types.purpose: Movement computer. preComputeSteering() + computeSteering() produce a Steering vector. Has activate()/deactivate() lifecycle.

types.name: BodyMotion
types.purpose: Body movement (translation). Has getSteeringMotion() for delegation.

types.name: HeadMotion
types.purpose: Head movement (look direction).

types.name: RoleStateChange
types.purpose: Lifecycle callbacks: registerWithSupport, motionControllerChanged, loaded, spawned, unloaded, removed, teleported.

interactions.overview: NPC interaction handlers for player-NPC interactions.

types.name: UseNPCInteraction
types.purpose: Default NPC interaction. When a player interacts with an NPC, notifies the NPC's blackboard InteractionView. Has a default root interaction '*UseNPC'.

types.name: ContextualUseNPCInteraction
types.purpose: Contextual NPC interaction that passes a context string to the NPC.

types.name: SpawnNPCInteraction
types.purpose: Block interaction that spawns an NPC. Uses weighted random selection from configured NPC types.

types.name: NPCInteractionSimulationHandler
types.purpose: Simulates interaction state for NPC-initiated interactions (e.g. NPC attacking). Manages charge time.

config.overview: NPC configuration assets for attitudes and balancing.

types.name: AttitudeGroup
types.purpose: JSON asset defining NPC attitude groups. Maps Attitude enum (IGNORE, HOSTILE, NEUTRAL, FRIENDLY, REVERED) to NPC group names. Loaded from NPC/Attitude/Roles.

types.name: ItemAttitudeGroup
types.purpose: JSON asset defining item attitude groups. Maps Sentiment enum (Ignore/Dislike/Neutral/Like/Love -> Attitude) to item tags. Loaded from NPC/Attitude/Items.

types.name: BalanceAsset
types.purpose: JSON asset for NPC combat balancing. Can specify an EntityEffect to apply at spawn. Loaded from NPC/Balancing. Supports inheritance.

blackboard.overview: Shared perception data system. The Blackboard is an ECS resource that provides views for different perception domains (block types, block events, entity events, combat, attitudes, interactions, resources). NPCs subscribe to views relevant to their role.

types.name: Blackboard
types.purpose: ECS resource providing typed views. Views are registered and accessed by class.

types.name: BlockTypeView
types.purpose: Tracks blocks of interest within NPC perception range.

types.name: BlockEventView
types.purpose: Tracks block change events (damage, break) filtered by BlockEventType and block set IDs.

types.name: EntityEventView
types.purpose: Tracks entity events filtered by EntityEventType.

types.name: AttitudeView
types.purpose: Provides attitude lookups for NPCs toward other entities.

types.name: AttitudeMap
types.purpose: Maps NPC group pairs to attitudes.

types.name: ItemAttitudeMap
types.purpose: Maps item tags to attitudes.

types.name: InteractionView
types.purpose: Tracks player-NPC interaction events.

types.name: CombatViewSystems
types.purpose: ECS systems for combat data pooling and tracking.

types.name: ReservationStatus
types.purpose: Player reservation state for NPC interactions.

types.name: EventNotification
types.purpose: Base event notification with initiator reference.

types.name: EntityEventNotification
types.purpose: Entity-specific event notification.

corecomponents.overview: ~200 types implementing all concrete Sensor, Action, BodyMotion, HeadMotion, EntityFilter, and EntityPrioritiser implementations. Organized by domain: audiovisual, combat, debug, entity, interaction, items, lifecycle, movement, statemachine, timer, utility, world.

decisionmaker.overview: Decision-making system with conditions and state evaluators. Conditions are data-driven (loaded from NPC/DecisionMaking/Conditions JSON) and used by the StateEvaluatorSystem to drive NPC state transitions.

types.name: Condition
types.purpose: Base condition asset. Loaded from JSON with inheritance support.

types.name: SimpleCondition
types.purpose: Basic boolean condition.

types.name: HasTargetCondition
types.purpose: Checks if NPC has a locked target.

types.name: IsInStateCondition
types.purpose: Checks if NPC is in a specific state.

types.name: LineOfSightCondition
types.purpose: Checks line of sight to target.

types.name: NearbyCountCondition
types.purpose: Checks count of nearby entities.

types.name: RandomiserCondition
types.purpose: Random chance condition.

types.name: SelfStatAbsoluteCondition
types.purpose: Checks NPC's own stat against absolute value.

types.name: SelfStatPercentageCondition
types.purpose: Checks NPC's own stat against percentage.

types.name: TargetDistanceCondition
types.purpose: Checks distance to target.

types.name: TargetMovementStateCondition
types.purpose: Checks target's movement state.

types.name: TargetStatAbsoluteCondition
types.purpose: Checks target's stat against absolute value.

types.name: TargetStatPercentageCondition
types.purpose: Checks target's stat against percentage.

types.name: TimeOfDayCondition
types.purpose: Checks world time of day.

types.name: TimeSinceLastUsedCondition
types.purpose: Checks time since condition was last used.

types.name: CurveCondition
types.purpose: Condition evaluated via a response curve.

types.name: ScaledCurveCondition
types.purpose: Scaled response curve condition.

types.name: StateEvaluator
types.purpose: ECS component that evaluates conditions to drive state transitions.

types.name: EvaluationContext
types.purpose: Context for condition evaluation.

types.name: Evaluator
types.purpose: Evaluates conditions in context.

state_transition.overview: State machine system for NPC behavior state transitions.

types.name: StateTransitionController
types.purpose: Controls state transitions based on evaluated conditions. Manages current state, transition edges, and state history.

types.name: BuilderStateTransition
types.purpose: Builder for state transition definitions from JSON.

types.name: BuilderStateTransitionController
types.purpose: Builder for the state transition controller.

types.name: BuilderStateTransitionEdges
types.purpose: Builder for transition edges between states.

systems.overview: 25+ ECS systems that form the NPC tick pipeline, registered in dependency order by NPCPlugin.setup().

types.name: BlackboardSystems
types.purpose: Init/Tick/DamageBlockEvent/BreakBlockEvent systems for the blackboard resource.

types.name: CombatViewSystems
types.purpose: Ensure/EntityRemoved/Ticking systems for combat data components.

types.name: NPCSystems
types.purpose: ModelChange/Added/AddedFromExternal/AddedFromWorldGen/AddSpawnEntityEffect/OnTeleport/OnDeath/LegacyWorldGenId/KillFeed/PrefabPlaceEntity systems.

types.name: RoleBuilderSystem
types.purpose: Builds roles from builders when entities are added.

types.name: BalancingInitialisationSystem
types.purpose: Applies balance assets (entity effects) at spawn.

types.name: RoleSystems
types.purpose: RoleActivate/BehaviourTick/PreBehaviourSupportTick/PostBehaviourSupportTick/RoleDebug systems.

types.name: PositionCacheSystems
types.purpose: RoleActivate/Update systems for position caching.

types.name: NPCInteractionSystems
types.purpose: AddSimulationManager/TickHeldInteractions for NPC-initiated interactions.

types.name: FailedSpawnSystem
types.purpose: Handles NPCs that failed to spawn.

types.name: StateEvaluatorSystem
types.purpose: Evaluates conditions and drives state transitions.

types.name: NPCPreTickSystem
types.purpose: Pre-tick setup (caches position, invalidates speed multiplier).

types.name: AvoidanceSystem
types.purpose: Computes avoidance steering from nearby NPCs.

types.name: SteeringSystem
types.purpose: Applies blended steering from all forces to NPC movement.

types.name: ComputeVelocitySystem
types.purpose: Converts steering output to velocity.

types.name: MovementStatesSystem
types.purpose: Updates movement state flags (walking, running, flying, etc.).

types.name: MessageSupportSystem
types.purpose: Beacon/NPCBlockEvent/PlayerBlockEvent/NPCEntityEvent/PlayerEntityEvent message delivery.

types.name: TimerSystem
types.purpose: Ticks named timers.

types.name: StepCleanupSystem
types.purpose: Cleans up step components after debug stepping.

types.name: NewSpawnStartTickingSystem
types.purpose: Starts ticking newly spawned NPCs.

types.name: RoleChangeSystem
types.purpose: Processes queued role changes (re-builds role, transfers components).

types.name: NPCSpatialSystem
types.purpose: Updates KDTree spatial index for NPC positions.

types.name: NPCDeathSystems
types.purpose: NPCKillsEntity/EntityView systems for death handling.

types.name: NPCDamageSystems
types.purpose: FilterDamage/DamageReceived/DamageDealt/DamageReceivedEventView/DropDeathItems systems.

types.name: NPCVelocityInstructionSystem
types.purpose: Applies velocity instructions from motion controllers.

types.name: SpawnReferenceSystems
types.purpose: Manages spawn marker and beacon references.
